references.text: The same offering (two turtledoves or two young pigeons) is required after a woman's purification period following childbirth, brought to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
An alternative offering of two turtledoves or two young pigeons for women who cannot afford a lamb, the same sacrificial animals as in 15:29.
Two turtledoves or two young pigeons are also used in the cleansing ritual for lepers, one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering.
Parallel text for men with a discharge - the same offering of two turtledoves or two young pigeons on the eighth day.
Basic instruction regarding burnt offerings from birds - turtledoves or young pigeons.
Two turtledoves or two young pigeons as a sin offering and a burnt offering for anyone who cannot afford livestock.
The Nazirite also brings two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest on the eighth day after becoming unclean.
Mary and Joseph brought this offering (a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons) at Jesus' presentation in the temple, in accordance with the Law of Moses.
